feeds.title: Food Storage Made Easy Blog
feeds.description: Food Storage Made Easy was started by two young moms, Jodi & Julie, who were trying to navigate the difficult world of food storage & preparedness. Through this blog, they share their preparedness, adventures, and information to help families be prepared for life's emergencies, big or small.
